name: PlantVillage: Plant Disease Classification Dataset
description: An open-access repository of plant leaf images created by Penn State University and EPFL to foster research in computer vision-based plant disease diagnosis. Consists of 54,306 curated photographs of healthy and diseased leaves across 14 major agricultural crop species (including apple, blueberry, cherry, corn, grape, peach, pepper, potato, raspberry, soybean, squash, strawberry, and tomato), categorized into 38 disease and health classes under controlled photographic settings.
